user_input: How can a fault indication be reset on a Grundfos pump?
reference_answer: A fault indication can be reset via the digital input if it has been set to alarm resetting, or by briefly pressing the reset/control button on the pump. This does not change the pump setting.

reference_evidence.quote:
8.1.4 Resetting of fault indications
Reset a fault indication in one of the following ways:
• Via the digital input if it has been set to Alarm resetting .
• Briefly press or on the pump. This does not change the
setting of the pump.
